d:
Daybitij se jujh rahe logon ke lie, pair men lagi chhoti si chot bhi ek bari samasya ban sakti hai. kabhi-kabhi iski vajah se gaingrin ho sakta hai, aur pair ka kuchh hissa ya pura pair tak katna par sakta hai.
Is riport men, eksapart ne 'daybitik phut dijij' ke khatron aur usse kaise bacha ja sakta hai, is bare men bataya hai.
Vidiyo riport mayuri som
Shut aur edit aarchisman saha
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
